description: Phases, activities and direct costs of the calculator. phases maps each research phase key to a description of the phase. Activities and direct costs are offered in the calculator's selectboxes, grouped by phase. phase is a research phase key ("incubation", "data" or "writing"). default_hours is a typical number of hours of labor for an activity. default_cost is a typical direct cost in US dollars. description describes what the activity or direct cost covers.

incubation.description: The incubation phase includes ideation and conception of the research questions, applications for ethics approval from an Institutional Review Board, and applications for grants (both successful and unsucessful).

data.description: This phase encompasses all activities and direct costs involved in carrying out the research.

writing.description: Encompasses the writing of the manuscript. This should include the presentation of versions of the manuscript to peers, such as at seminars and conferences, as peer feedback is generally crucial for the development of journal articles. Also include the time spent on revising manuscripts for resubmission.

editing.description: The cost of peer review and journal editorial work is based on the number of journals the manuscript was submitted to before it was published, and the average number of peer review rounds across the journal submissions.

activities.name: Ideation and conception
activities.description: Developing the research question, reviewing the literature and designing the study.

activities.name: Ethics approval
activities.description: Preparing and revising applications to an ethics committee or institutional review board.

activities.name: Grant applications
activities.description: Writing, revising and submitting applications for funding for the project.

activities.name: Other
activities.description: Any other incubation activity not listed above.

activities.name: Data collection
activities.description: Recruiting participants and gathering data, e.g. through surveys, interviews, experiments or fieldwork.

activities.name: Interview transcription
activities.description: Transcribing recorded interviews or focus groups into text for analysis.

activities.name: Data analysis
activities.description: Cleaning, coding and analysing the data, and interpreting the results.

activities.name: Other
activities.description: Any other data collection or analysis activity not listed above.

activities.name: Writing and manuscript preparation
activities.description: Drafting, revising and formatting the manuscript for submission to a journal.

activities.name: Conferencing (labor)
activities.description: Time spent preparing for, travelling to and presenting the research at conferences.

direct_costs.name: Participant incentivization
direct_costs.description: Payments, vouchers or gifts given to participants for taking part in the study.

direct_costs.name: Software
direct_costs.description: Licences or subscriptions for software used in the research, e.g. for analysis or surveys.

direct_costs.name: Databases
direct_costs.description: Access fees for databases or datasets used in the research.

direct_costs.name: Conferencing (direct costs)
direct_costs.description: Registration fees, travel and accommodation for presenting the research at conferences.

direct_costs.name: Proofreading and Editing Services
direct_costs.description: Professional proofreading, copyediting or language editing of the manuscript.
